comments: Three stock plans, one story each, for the stock plan pool tests (#225, #235).
Plan A (1000 reserved): a-bad grants 200 to a stakeholder who isn't in the stakeholders file, then a-good grants 300 to one who is.
Plan B (100 reserved): b-1 grants 80 and b-2 grants 30, which is 10 more than the plan has.

Plan C (500 reserved): c-1 grants 100 under the older name TX_PLAN_SECURITY_ISSUANCE. c-cancel cancels 40 of it and names c-balance, a grant of the 60 that are left. c-return puts the 40 back in the pool.
